note: Common Criteria (CC1–CC9) apply to every SOC 2; A/C/PI/P criteria apply when those categories are in scope.

criteria.name: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
Quality information is obtained and used to support internal control
Identifies and analyzes risks to the achievement of objectives
Identifies and assesses changes that could impact the system of internal control
Evaluations are used to ascertain whether controls are operating
Control activities over technology are selected and developed
Logical access security software, infrastructure and architecture are implemented to protect information
Registration and authorization of new internal and external users before granting access
Access is modified and removed on a timely basis (role change / termination)
Security measures protect against threats from sources outside system boundaries
Transmission, movement and removal of information is restricted to authorized users and processes
Controls to prevent or detect and act upon the introduction of unauthorized or malicious software
Detection and monitoring to identify configuration changes and vulnerabilities
System components are monitored for anomalies indicative of security events
Security events are evaluated to determine whether they constitute incidents
Incidents are responded to through a defined incident response program
Identified incidents are resolved, and recovery is performed
Changes to infrastructure, data, software and procedures are authorized, designed, tested and approved
Vendor and business partner risks are assessed and managed
Environmental protections, backup processes and recovery infrastructure are implemented
Confidential information is identified and maintained
Confidential information is disposed of to meet objectives
Personal information is collected, used, retained and disclosed consistent with the entity's objectives
